description: This file defines a Wizard class used for building conditional formatting rules in PhpSpreadsheet. It provides methods to create rule-specific wizard instances based on rule types and conditionals.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A factory/helper class for creating conditional formatting rule wizard instances based on rule type or existing conditional objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Wizard with a specific cell range for applying rules.

methods.name: newRule
methods.description: Creates and returns a wizard object for a specific rule type.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates and returns a wizard object based on an existing Conditional object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Wizard with a specified cell range.

methods.name: newRule
methods.description: Generates a new wizard rule instance based on the provided rule type string.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates a wizard rule instance from a Conditional object.
